title: 第463章 再战第462章 夺术
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 与此同时。
看到裴苏已经沉浸在参悟之中，雪无痕也不再有任何顾忌。他彻底放开了手脚，将自己那堪比天人境的庞大真灵之力催动到了极致。
云辛杰本是凭着法诀勉强与之抗衡，随着时间推移，雪无痕强悍的真灵依旧占据了上风。
“逆子，你的死期到了！给我灭！”
识海深处，雪无痕的真灵化作一尊漆黑的魔影，张开血盆大口，狠狠地咬向了云辛杰那已经摇摇欲坠的灵魂本源。
“不！我恨！我好恨啊——！”
伴随着最后一声充满着无尽怨毒与绝望的惨嚎在识海中彻底消散，云辛杰的灵魂本源被雪无痕一口吞噬，连一丝真灵碎片都没有留下。
肉身上的挣扎终于停止了。
那半张扭曲的年轻面孔渐渐平复，最终，两幅面孔完美地融合在了一起。
这具年轻、充满力量、汇聚了数十位天骄本源的完美肉躯，终于彻彻底底地落入了雪无痕的掌控之中。
许久之后。
裴苏与占据了新身体的雪无痕，几乎在同一时间齐齐睁开了双眼。
裴苏的眼底闪过一抹深邃的紫芒，随即便被纯粹的黑亮所取代。
他微微运转起独门的望气术，内视己身，确认那法门已经牢牢地印刻在记忆深处，经脉运行路线也毫无滞涩，不似有假。
“果然是巧夺天工的奇术，虽然阴损，但这其中对灵魂的剖析，确实令人叹为观止。”
裴苏心中暗自评判。
而在剑池的另一边。
雪无痕缓缓从地上站起身来，感受着体内那犹如长江大河般奔腾不息的生命气息，眼中爆发出难以抑制的狂喜。
成功了！
“咔咔咔……”
就在这时，一阵轻微的碎裂声从不远处传来。
两人一同望去，只见雪无痕自己原本的那具肉身，在失去了真灵的温养后，竟然像是一件经历了千万年风化的古董一般，表面浮现出无数斑驳的锈迹。
他这具躯体似乎早年曾受过无法逆转的致命重伤，导致生机断绝，寿元早已干涸到了尽头。
如今真灵一经离开，这具腐朽的躯壳便再也支撑不住。
一阵微风吹过，那具曾经威震南境的阁主之躯，刹那间化作了漫天的飞雪与灰烬，彻底消散在了这幽暗的溶洞之中。
看着自己旧日的皮囊灰飞烟灭，雪无痕的眼中却连一丝一毫的痛惜都不曾有，而是暗芒闪烁，随即转过身。
面向裴苏，他神情变化了几次，似乎在斟酌着什么，不过最后还是呵呵笑了两声。
“多谢世子成全。从今往后，世上再无阁主雪无痕。”
裴苏没有说话，而是看着他，似乎在等待着他的臣服。
然而先前向着裴苏承诺臣服的雪无痕，此刻却像忘了这回事一般，只是沉着脸，环看四周。
好似在思虑着什么。
“这飞雪岛上的动静太大，现在还需世子配合我将一切推到枯剑身上。”
他在原地踱了两步，眼神阴狠地说道。
“虽然枯剑被世子所杀，不过也无妨。既然他死了，大可以将所有的罪名尽数扣在他头上。而我‘云辛杰’则是在这场浩劫中，侥幸逃脱的唯一幸存者。如此一来……”
content_en:
at the same time.
Seeing that Pei Su was already immersed in understanding, Xue Wuhen no longer had any scruples. He completely let go of his hands and feet, and pushed his huge true spirit power to the extreme, which was comparable to the heavenly realm.
Yun Xinjie could barely compete with him with the help of magic techniques, but as time passed, Xue Wuhen's powerful true spirit still gained the upper hand.
"Sir, your death has come! Kill me!"
Deep in the sea of ​​consciousness, Xue Wuhen's true spirit turned into a dark demonic shadow, opened its bloody mouth, and bit hard at Yun Xinjie's already shaky soul origin.
"No! I hate it! I hate it so much——!"
With the last miserable howl filled with endless resentment and despair completely dissipated in the sea of consciousness, Yun Xinjie's soul was swallowed up by Xue Wuhen, leaving not even a fragment of the true spirit behind.
The physical struggle finally stopped.
The distorted half of the young face gradually calmed down, and finally, the two faces merged together perfectly.
This young, powerful, perfect body that gathered the origins of dozens of geniuses finally fell completely into Xue Wuhen's control.
After a long time.
Pei Su and Xue Wuhen, who occupied the new body, opened their eyes almost at the same time.
A deep purple light flashed across Pei Su's eyes, which was then replaced by pure black light.
He slightly activated his unique Qi-gazing technique and looked inside himself, confirming that the technique had been firmly engraved in the depths of his memory, and that the meridians were not stagnant and did not seem to be fake.
"It is indeed an ingenious thaumaturgy. Although it is destructive, the analysis of the soul is truly breathtaking."
Pei Su judged secretly in his heart.
And on the other side of the sword pool.
Xue Wuhen slowly stood up from the ground, feeling the breath of life in his body that was rushing like the Yangtze River, and uncontrollable ecstasy burst out in his eyes.
Success!
"Kakaka..."
At this moment, a slight cracking sound came from not far away.
The two of them looked together and saw that Xue Wuhen's original body, after losing the warmth of the true spirit, turned out to be like an antique that had experienced millions of years of weathering, with countless mottled rust stains appearing on the surface.
His body seemed to have suffered irreversible fatal injuries in his early years, which led to the loss of life and the longevity had long since dried up to the end.
Now that the true spirit has left, this decaying body can no longer hold up.
"Wow--"
A gust of breeze blew by, and the body of the pavilion master who once shocked the southern realm instantly turned into flying snow and ashes all over the sky, completely dissipating in the dark cave.
...
Seeing his old skin turned into ashes, Xue Wuhen's eyes did not show even a trace of regret, but a dark light flickered, and then he turned around.
Facing Pei Su, his expression changed several times, as if he was thinking about something, but in the end he laughed twice.
"Thank you so much, Your Majesty. From now on, there will be no Pavilion Master Xue Wuhen in the world."
Pei Su did not speak, but looked at him, as if waiting for his surrender.
However, Xue Wuhen, who had previously promised to surrender to Pei Su, seemed to have forgotten about it at the moment, and just looked around with a sullen face.
He seemed to be thinking about something.
"The commotion on Feixue Island is too great. Now I still need the Crown Prince to cooperate with me to push everything onto Kujian."
He took a few steps in place and said with a sinister look in his eyes.
"Although Ku Jian was killed by the Crown Prince, it doesn't matter. Since he is dead, all the charges can be pinned on him. And I, 'Yun Xinjie', am the only survivor who managed to escape in this catastrophe. In this way..."
